syllabus_source.body: National Medical Commission (UGMEB), published by NTA
syllabus_source.version: Updated syllabus for NEET (UG) 2026: NMC letter U-14023/19/NEET (UG Exam)/UGMEB dated 22-12-2025, NTA notice dated 08-01-2026
syllabus_source.note: Physics 20 units, Chemistry 20 units, Biology 10 units. No 2027 syllabus found as of 2026-09-29; pages say 2027 follows this one ❓. nmc.org.in did not load cleanly, so I used NTA's copy of the NMC letter. Botany and Zoology are not split in the official syllabus; they are search terms on the Biology topic.
